description: Design tokens for the Iress Design System — colours, spacing, radius, and typography as CSS custom properties and typed JavaScript objects.

skills.name: token-usage
skills.description: How to correctly use IDS design tokens in React components and CSS. Covers import patterns, common mistakes, usage rules by category, theming, and complete token enumeration.

css.description: CSS custom properties stylesheet — import once, use var() references anywhere

cssVars.description: Type-safe JavaScript object of var() strings with embedded fallbacks — recommended for CSS-in-JS and inline styles

designTokens.description: Raw token schema with $value, $type, $description metadata — for tooling and inspection only, not for styling

tokenCategories.name: colour
tokenCategories.description: Semantic colour palette: neutral (10-90), primary, accent, system (success/danger/warning/info), data visualisation (subtle/bold 10-90), and global interactions

tokenCategories.name: spacing
tokenCategories.description: Spacing scale based on 0.25rem (4px) base unit. Values: 0-8 and 10 (no 9). Aliases: none, xs, sm, md, lg, xl

tokenCategories.name: radius
tokenCategories.description: Border radius scale based on 0.25rem (4px) base unit. Values: 0-4. System tokens for button, form, layout, pill, tag

tokenCategories.name: typography
tokenCategories.description: Typography composite tokens for headings (1-5), body (sm/md × regular/medium/strong/em), and code. Base fonts: Ubuntu (headings), Inter (body), Space (code)

components.description: The components package has styling-props guides that cover token usage from the component perspective

meta.source: Curated index for AI agent discovery of the @iress-oss/ids-tokens package
